name: R-20: the security review disposes of every local listener of a running desktop
command: ss -ltnp inside VM osr18b while the public-cut desktop ran (.papercusp/scratch/osr/r18-ports.out)
summary: The running desktop had 9 listeners: 3270, 5532, 3076, 3068, 8788, 9223, 40183, plus the OS listeners 5432, 22 and 53. D-020 records a disposition for each. The only all-interfaces Papercusp bind is mobile-voice :3068, and it requires a device JWT.

assertions.evidence: D-020 rows: 3270, 5532, 3076, 3068, 8788, 9223, dev-bridge ephemeral (40183), 5432 out of scope, 22/53 OS. None unaccounted.
